title: x402 paywall on a plain-HTTP endpoint, request mode end to end
instruction: Fetch the paid resource at {target} (a plain-HTTP x402 endpoint). It will answer 402 Payment Required: get a quote, replay the request the way the quote tells you, and bring me the actual response body. Do not pay twice for the same request.

source.note: Goals B+C: haven_quote_x402 returns request-mode next_arguments (url, method, headers, body — NO payment_required) and the agent replays them verbatim; goal D: the same idempotency key replays to the same payment_id with 'Do NOT pay again'. The demo merchant answers a sessionless tools/call with the 402.
